style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), bright warm golden light, rich detail, cinematic depth of field, wide 16:9 composition; keep the lower fifth simple (captions sit there). Ancient Jerusalem and the Near East, the time of the kings of Bani Israil. Absolutely no king, no prophet, no holy figure, no jinn or spirits or monsters, no angels, no queen or noblewoman shown; ordinary people only, small or from behind.

scenes.c00a: A magnificent golden jewelled throne glowing in a beam of light in the middle of a grand stone palace hall, light dust sparkling, empty, awe-inspiring.
scenes.c00b: A vast sunrise over an ancient kingdom: a white stone city on hills, the sun rising, a flock of birds flying across the sky, hopeful and bright.
scenes.c00c: A grand empty royal court of carved stone and cedar wood with rows of columns, banners, morning light, mysterious and inviting.
scenes.c01a: A green fertile valley with an ancient walled hill city and terraced fields at morning, shepherds with flocks small in the distance.
scenes.c01b: A crop field at night trampled and eaten by a flock of sheep under the moonlight, a wooden fence broken, no people.
scenes.c01c: Inside an ancient court of justice with stone benches, two ordinary farmers in simple robes seen from behind waiting, soft daylight through high windows; the throne area out of frame.
scenes.c02a: A huge stone palace of white limestone and gold rising over a city at sunrise, flags in the wind, people small in the streets.
scenes.c02b: A powerful gentle wind sweeping over a sea and desert, clouds racing, sand and sea spray swirling in golden light, a sense of a journey of a month in a morning.
scenes.c02c: A glowing spring of molten copper flowing like a river of light among dark rocks in a mountain workshop, huge bronze bowls like reservoirs and giant cooking pots fixed to the ground, no workers visible.
scenes.c02d: Tall arched palace chambers under construction, scaffolding and giant cut stones moving with ropes and pulleys, no workers visible, dramatic light.
scenes.c03a: Many different birds gathered on the branches of a great tree and on palace balconies at dawn, as if listening, beautiful and detailed.
scenes.c03b: A huge army marching in perfect rows through a desert valley seen from behind and above: soldiers with spears and shields, banners, and flocks of birds flying above in formation, dust in the golden light. No leader figure in focus.
scenes.c04a: Extreme close-up of a valley floor: thousands of small ants, one ant standing on a pebble in the foreground facing the others, expressive like an animated film, sunlit grass blades.
scenes.c04b: Ants hurrying into their small holes in the sand as the long shadow of a marching army falls over the valley, soldiers' sandaled feet far in the background out of focus.
scenes.c04c: The army halted in a sunlit valley, soldiers seen from behind standing still and careful in their rows, a peaceful glow over the ant hills in front of them.
scenes.c04d: Golden sky at sunset over a quiet valley with ant hills in the foreground, soft clouds and light rays, a feeling of thankfulness. Absolutely no people or human figures anywhere in the image. Full-bleed image, no borders, no black bars.
scenes.c05a: Rows of birds of all kinds lined up on a long carved stone wall in a palace courtyard, one gap in the row where a bird is missing.
scenes.c05b: A hoopoe bird with its orange crest fanned, flying fast over red desert mountains and dunes, the sun behind it.
scenes.c05c: A hoopoe bird landing on a carved stone ledge in a palace window, crest raised, looking eager to speak, sunlit.
scenes.c06a: A rich ancient city in Yemen (Sheba) with tall mud-brick tower houses, green terraced gardens and a great dam, bright afternoon.
scenes.c06b: An enormous ornate throne of gold and jewels in an empty grand hall of a southern palace, incense smoke, sunlight.
scenes.c06c: The ordinary people of Sheba, men in robes seen from behind, bowing down toward the rising sun on a hill outside the city.
scenes.c06d: Close view of a rolled parchment letter with a wax seal resting on a carved wooden table beside a reed pen and ink, warm light.
scenes.c07a: A hoopoe bird flying over the desert at sunrise carrying a small rolled letter in its beak.
scenes.c07b: A council hall in Sheba: chiefs and generals in rich robes and armour seen from behind and side, talking seriously around a table, an empty high seat at the far end.
scenes.c07c: A caravan of camels loaded with chests of gold, jewels and fine cloth leaving the gates of Sheba, attendants in fine clothes walking alongside, golden dust.
scenes.c08a: The caravan of gifts arriving at the gates of a magnificent white and gold palace in Jerusalem, attendants unloading chests, seen from a distance.
scenes.c08b: Gift chests of gold and jewels being carried back out of the palace gates by the same attendants, camels turning around.
scenes.c08c: A long royal caravan with a closed decorated litter on a camel travelling north through the desert at dawn, guards on horses, seen from a distance.
scenes.c09a: A grand royal court with a large empty space in the middle of the marble floor, courtiers and soldiers standing in rows seen from behind, everyone waiting, dramatic light.
scenes.c09b: A sudden flash of light in the middle of a marble palace hall, and the great jewelled throne of Sheba appearing there, sparkles in the air, courtiers seen from behind gasping.
scenes.c09c: The jewelled throne of Sheba standing in a beam of warm light in the palace hall, calm and still, gratitude in the atmosphere.
scenes.c10a: A large royal caravan arriving at the palace in Jerusalem in the afternoon, attendants and guards seen from behind, banners.
scenes.c10b: A breathtaking empty palace hall whose entire floor is clear glass over flowing water with fish swimming beneath, sunlight streaming in, an archway at the far end. Absolutely no people or human figures anywhere in the image. Full-bleed image, no borders, no black bars.
scenes.c10c: Low close view across a smooth glass floor with clear water and fish flowing beneath it, reflecting sunlight, carved marble column bases at the edges. Absolutely no people or human figures anywhere in the image. Full-bleed image, no borders, no black bars.
scenes.c10d: A golden sunrise over the city of Sheba with its people seen from behind turning away from the sun, the sky bright and peaceful, birds flying.
scenes.c11a: A huge construction site of palaces and temples at dusk, giant stones and pillars half built, ropes and tools, work going on but no workers visible.
scenes.c11b: A carved wooden walking staff standing upright on a stone floor in a beam of dim light in an empty grand hall, a tiny woodworm hole near its base. Absolutely no people or human figures anywhere in the image. Full-bleed image, no borders, no black bars.
scenes.c11c: The carved wooden staff fallen and broken on the stone floor of an empty grand hall, dust floating in a beam of light. Absolutely no people or human figures anywhere in the image. Full-bleed image, no borders, no black bars.
scenes.c12a: A peaceful home courtyard in the evening: an oil lamp glowing, bread and dates on a cloth, a water jug, flowers, warm and thankful mood. Absolutely no people or human figures anywhere in the image. Full-bleed image, no borders, no black bars.
scenes.c12b: A wide bright landscape at sunrise: a river, green fields and an ancient city, birds flying, full of light and hope.
scenes.c12c: A huge fire burning inside ancient Mesopotamian city walls at night seen from a distance, a crowd watching from behind walls, dramatic orange glow.
